verdict.rationale: A live probe returned HTTP 200 for an llms.txt at developers.clerky.com that indexes markdown (.md) versions of the developer docs. Those markdown pages, covering the Partner API introduction, lifecycle, authentication and the MCP server, are themselves agent-readable docs. The handbooks site has no llms.txt or .md pages (404), so this coverage is limited to the developer portal. Missing for 10: agent-oriented docs for the handbooks/legal-concepts content, and independent community corroboration of agents using the llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developers.clerky.com/llms.txt - [Lifecycle](https://developers.clerky.com/getting-started/lifecycle/index.md): How a partner creates, fills, and tracks a document set.
The Clerky Partner API lets partners bring a Clerky-powered formation workflow into their own product.
